fields.hero_prompt: Build a training acknowledgment form that saves every response to a database I own.

faq_plan.q: What is a training acknowledgment form?
How do I create a training acknowledgment form?

plan.angle: The live top 10 is signature sheets: a city PDF where staff confirm they watched a class in its entirety, a college and a back-office PDF, Lumin, Mitti and Jotform templates, a Westlaw standard form and a Texas agency volunteer form. Each one stops at a name, a date and a signature line on paper. This page builds the acknowledgment as a training record: a crew signing a toolbox talk on one tablet at the job site, an online course with check questions before the signature, an equipment sign-off that the trainer co-signs, and refresher dates that come due on a dashboard, then answers what the form is, what the statement says and who signs it.
tab_stories: At Halvorsen Roofing, crew lead Dario Mendhall gives a 15-minute ladder safety talk at the Elm Street job, and all 9 roofers sign on his tablet, so the record holds the topic, the trainer, the site and 9 signatures.
Quillfeather Software assigns a 25-minute phishing awareness video to 64 staff, each answers 3 check questions before signing, and the 5 who missed a question go back to the video, so 59 have signed.

At Saltgrass Kitchen, chef Abel Strand trains new line cook Wynn Cardoza on the meat slicer, Wynn signs, and Abel co-signs after watching him take it apart and clean it, so the record shows Wynn cleared on March 12.

Ostrander Property Group repeats fire extinguisher training every 12 months, and its dashboard shows 4 of 22 maintenance technicians due within 30 days, so facilities manager Marguerite Osei sends each of the 4 an email reminder.

claims_to_source: Lumin: a training acknowledgement form is used by employers to verify that an employee has attended and understood a required training session
Westlaw Practical Law: a standard form to confirm and acknowledge an employee's attendance and understanding of training provided by an employer
Little Rock: by signing, the employee confirms they watched the training class listed in its entirety
Mitti: a training acknowledgment template captures date, trainer, branch, type of training, and topics covered
Signature Back Office: the safety training acknowledgment reads I acknowledge that I have attended this training session
Texas DFPS: one agency form documents that a direct-service volunteer or intern has completed all trainings required

chip_adds: Add group sign-offs, with each attendee signing on one tablet.
